 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Dinesh Kumar Sharma

ORDER % 21.04.2023 Exemption allowed subject to just exceptions.
There is no ground for stay of the proceedings before the learned Trial Court.

The present petition has been filed with the following prayer:
" To quash and set aside the FIR bearing No. 47/2019 registered at Police Station Pul Prahladpur, South East, Delhi and charge sheet No.1 dated 18.06.2019 for offences under Sections 498A, 406, 509 and 34 I.P.C and proceedings arising out of it, against the petitioner."
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that another quashing petitioner bearing CRL.M.C.5839/2022 has been filed by the co-accused which is fixed for 18.10.2023.
Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
